messages:
Sofia Patel: Heads up — invoice from CloudCompute GmbH (DE) for €12,150. Invoice CC-2026-042 arrived but there's no VAT ID and they noted 'reverse charge applies'. AP flagged it.
Jared Kim: Can you drop the pdf here? If no VAT ID AP will hold. @Marco Liu (Legal) any quick guidance?
Sofia Patel: Uploaded the invoice to the thread. Vendor emailed: 'we are a small provider and didn't register until now' — not ideal.
Ananya Rao: If they're unregistered in DE, reverse charge generally isn't valid. We need supplier VAT ID to apply reverse charge. Otherwise vendor should charge VAT and we reclaim via VAT return.
Marco Liu (Legal): Correct — reverse charge requires a valid supplier VAT number. Don't process as reverse charge without it. Ask vendor for a corrected invoice or their VAT registration docs. If they can't provide it, request an invoice with VAT charged.
ap-bot: Invoice CC-2026-042 uploaded to AP queue. Status: pending tax verification.
Jared Kim: Got it. I'll ping the vendor and ask for a corrected invoice and VAT ID. Quick Q for the group — if they refuse and charge VAT, do we gross-up or absorb? Our policy?
Ananya Rao: We don't gross-up for EU VAT. We pay whatever VAT is charged. Gross-up is usually discussed for withholding tax where the payer is asked to increase the amount to cover tax.
Sofia Patel: Also unrelated but FYI: the US contractor (Freelancer LLC) in last week's run submitted a W-8BEN-E. Payment team thinks they should have a W-9 on file. Need to confirm their tax residency before release.
Jared Kim: If they're a US person -> W-9 required. If foreign -> W-8 variant. If we don't have correct form and backup withholding rules apply, AP may need to withhold (backup withholding currently 24%).
Marco Liu (Legal): Action items: (1) @Jared ask CloudCompute for VAT ID or corrected invoice. (2) @Sofia confirm contractor's residency and request W-9 if US. Loop me in if vendor pushes back.
Sofia Patel: Will do. For now I'll code invoice as 'Professional services — VAT pending' so GL doesn't break. ETA to vendor by EOD; will update thread.
Jared Kim: Ping sent just now. Vendor replied: they registered today and sent updated invoice with VAT ID DE123456789. Attached.
Sofia Patel: Received updated invoice. Forwarding to AP to process net under reverse charge and mark VAT reclaim in the VAT tracker.
ap-bot: Invoice CC-2026-042 status updated -> ready for payment.
Sofia Patel: Thanks everyone. Will follow up on contractor W-9 separately and post in this thread when resolved.
Marco Liu (Legal): Thanks — keep the documents in Confluence under Finance > VAT docs. If any withholding/gross-up escalation, ping me directly.
